mapper.insert: INSERT INTO serial_http_command(id,enterprise_id,warehouse_id,command_id,request_hash,action,actor_id,created_at) VALUES (#{id},#{enterprise},#{warehouse},#{command},#{hash},#{action},#{actor},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT request_hash,result FROM serial_http_command WHERE enterprise_id=#{enterprise} AND command_id=#{command} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE serial_http_command SET result=#{result} WHERE enterprise_id=#{enterprise} AND command_id=#{command} AND result IS NULL
